description: Add a slide to a presentation. sortOrder defaults to the end. layout is one of: title, title-body, split-text-viz, split-viz-text, viz-full, stat, section-divider, freeform (default "freeform" — prefer it; the others are legacy).

layout.description: Slide layout. Defaults to freeform (preferred); slot layouts are legacy.

sortOrder.description: Position (0-based). Omit to append at the end.

name: add_slide
